title: Associate Director of the Harvard Foundation
bio: Matias Ramos has served as an administrator at Harvard College for seven years, initially in the Phillips Brooks House Center for Public Service and Engaged Scholarship and at the Dean of Students Office since 2022. Prior to joining the College, Matias founded a national immigrant youth advocacy organization and led communications for a global project at Tufts. Matias is a graduate of UCLA with a degree in Political Science and completed a graduate certificate in Philosophy and Ethics at the Harvard Extension School. He is currently enrolled in the Harvard Kennedy School Mid-Career Master of Public Administration Program. Matias also serves as a Pre-Concentration Advisor through the College’s Advising Programs Office. He is an experienced coach and strategist who can advise first-generation, low-income (FGLI) / undocumented immigrant students, student leaders, and student organizations.
